gloss: beloved wife; wife one married for love

definitions.gloss: beloved wife; wife one married for love
definitions.explanation: A wife whom one married out of romantic love rather than through an arranged marriage. Carries a warm, affectionate nuance. Somewhat old-fashioned in tone.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{恋女房|こいにょうぼう}を{大切|たいせつ}にしている。
{恋女房|こいにょうぼう}と{二人|ふたり}で{小|ちい}さな{店|みせ}を{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: He started a small shop together with his beloved wife.

examples.japanese: {周囲|しゅうい}の{反対|はんたい}を{押|お}し{切|き}って{結婚|けっこん}した{恋女房|こいにょうぼう}と、もう30{年|ねん}になる。
examples.english: It's been 30 years since I married my beloved wife against everyone's objections.

notes:
Composed of {恋|こい} (romantic love) and {女房|にょうぼう} (wife, somewhat old-fashioned). The word implies that the marriage was a love match ({恋愛結婚|れんあいけっこん}) as opposed to an arranged marriage ({見合|みあ}い{結婚|けっこん}). Has a warm, slightly nostalgic tone and is used more in narrative or literary contexts than everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {恋女房|こいにょうぼう}と{一緒|いっしょ}に: together with one's beloved wife
- {恋女房|こいにょうぼう}をめとる: to take a beloved wife

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {愛妻|あいさい}: beloved wife — a more modern and common term
- {女房|にょうぼう}: wife — the base word, somewhat old-fashioned/casual
- {妻|つま}: wife — the standard neutral term
- {奥|おく}さん: wife (of someone else) — polite everyday term
